decisions.reason: Changing the selected YouTube video URL does not alter the existing policy to exclude the video from the Android package and stream it from YouTube.
The selected how-to video URL does not change Android full-app localization coverage or language requirements.
The selected how-to video URL does not change iOS full-app localization coverage or language requirements.
Selecting a different YouTube URL does not change Android OS, API, dependency, or framework modernization requirements.
Selecting a different YouTube URL has no effect on Android permission usage or removal requirements.
